summary: Introduce fail-closed architecture inventory, impact evidence, dependency checks, and pull-request diff enforcement.

impacts.evidence: The gate adds no request or persistence path and preserves the Task 002 tenant-scope boundary.
Every protected change must classify privacy and data-governance impact with bounded non-sensitive rationale.
No REST or OpenAPI shape changes; Task 024 remains the semantic public-contract gate.
No event schema or envelope changes; version and compatibility checks remain owned by Task 024.
Provider admission stays disabled until Tasks 010, 025, 029, and 064 establish the SDK and conformance boundary.
No SQL changes are introduced; Task 067 continues to enforce migration metadata and rehearsal.
Strict bounded parsing, path and symlink checks, dependency rules, and self-protection reduce architecture bypasses.
Machine evidence supports an architecture reviewer but cannot replace protected hosting approval rules.
Append-only task-linked review records preserve decision and changed-path lineage in repository history.
The build-time gate performs no business effects and does not change reconciliation or retry semantics.
The checker is offline build tooling and creates no webhook, network, or runtime egress path.
CI reports deterministic bounded diagnostics and a concise inventory count for required-check observability.
A policy regression blocks merge; correction uses a new reviewed change and accepted ADRs are superseded, not rewritten.
Static, diff, import-direction, malformed-input, and provider-admission negative tests become mandatory CI checks.
